coordinateSource: manual inspection of whole frames and coordinate-labelled grids; no bbox-extremum or auto-fit landmarks

definitions.ankleL/ankleR: physical joint center: occluded -> null in all24
definitions.estimatedAnkleCenter: manual visual guess of internal ankle center from boot bend; separate from physical ankle, 8-10px uncertainty
definitions.heelL/heelR: visible rear-most heel/outsole profile midpoint of drawn boot, not native mean vertex landmark or inferred floor contact
definitions.toeL/toeR: visible frontmost toe profile midpoint on drawn boot; not bbox bottom, physical contact or native vertex-mean counterpart
definitions.satchelClaspCenter: center of visible large gold flap clasp on satchel; NOT waist belt buckle or Hips joint
definitions.waistBuckleCenter: null: waist-belt hardware cannot be identified independently of satchel/strap fittings
definitions.uncertaintyPx: manual radial visual uncertainty estimate in original art pixels; not statistical confidence or measured residual
